与旅行一起成长(Growing up with travel): 一篇关于旅行出行的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。

Jack thanked Leo for the honest advice. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. For example, we got up early to watch the sunrise.

People around Jack often share different ideas about the old town. Jack has practiced football for three years and won a prize last term. Little by little, things began to change. Also, a small tugboat guided the giant freighter into port.
The experience taught Jack more than any book could. Jack's dream job is to be a teacher. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Bike share docks pepper the city centre.

The train station has become an important part of daily life. Leo advised Jack to try swimming as a new hobby. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. A kind passenger helped me with my suitcase.
Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
